guaranteedRewards.name: Redridge Goulash
tooltip: Use: Restores 58 health over 21 sec. Must remain seated while eating. If you spend at least 10 sec eating, you will become well fed and gain 3 Intellect for 15 min. Additionally, experience gained from kills is increased by 5%.

narrative.details:
Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
narrative.objectives: Chef Breanna of Lakeshire wants five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
narrative.offerRewardText: Well done, adventurer. Such fine specimens too! And here is your delicious delicacy known as Redridge Goulash!
narrative.requestItemsText: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
